editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a gritty, old-school New York City where danger is hiding around every corner. You follow Sheila Bennet and Matt Krane, a couple who have smuggled a bunch of expensive jewels from Cuba. They are just trying to sell the loot and get away with it, but the cops are breathing down their necks. While they are worrying about jail, the city is facing a much scarier problem. A mysterious person is spreading smallpox, and the government is freaking out trying to stop a massive outbreak. It feels like two different movies happening at once, which keeps you guessing about how these stories will eventually crash into each other.

The acting is solid for the time, and the tension builds up nicely as the police close in. You will love how the movie mixes a crime story with a medical disaster, though some parts move a bit slower than others. If you enjoy vintage crime dramas, you should definitely check this one out. Since it is an older film, it looks great if you can find a restored version.
endingExplained: The movie ends when the police finally catch up to Sheila and Matt just as the health officials find the person spreading the disease. It turns out the jewel thief and the smallpox spreader were connected in a way that catches you by surprise. The couple is arrested for their smuggling, and the city is saved from the plague. Everything wraps up quickly with the bad guys in handcuffs and the city finally safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic noir and medical mysteries.
